evidence: Carries the Wallet label, modifies `src/wallet/db.cpp` and `src/wallet/wallet.cpp`, and updates `test/functional/wallet_multiwallet.py`.
rationale: Fixes Windows wallet path resolution where missing symlink detection causes `ListDatabases` to recursively traverse symlinked directories and `GetWalletPath` to treat symlinks as regular files. This resolves an ongoing platform inconsistency that previously required disabling multiwallet symlink tests on Windows.
